name: ux-craft
description: Decide or review how a React + shadcn/ui application's pages, flows, and names should work before styling them. page-structure picks or audits the layout, zones, hierarchy, action placement, states, and app shell of one page; user-flow designs the step sequence, confirmations, exits, and post-submit path for one task; ui-naming keeps labels, buttons, navigation, errors, and terminology consistent, with a read-only JSX-aware scanner that enforces the project's UX.md glossary. All three read and extend a project-level UX.md so decisions persist.
